categories.question: Everyone brings one comfort item to a stargazing night. What do you bring?

outcomes.name: A double sleeping quilt
outcomes.description: Thick open navy double camping quilt with a tiny stitched moon motif

outcomes.name: A thermos of cocoa
outcomes.description: Red insulated flask pouring cocoa into a cup with a marshmallow

outcomes.name: A red-light headlamp
outcomes.description: Black fabric headlamp with a single softly glowing red lens

outcomes.name: A reclining camp chair
outcomes.description: Comfortable blue folding camp chair tilted back for watching the sky
